CustomField.description: BR-15. Human context only: what the agreed next action actually is. NEVER A QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENT - a blank value does not prevent SQL, no Flow condition reads it, and no NorthstarIQ control will interpret it. It exists because the project thesis is explainability: a reader looking at a qualified Lead should see WHAT was agreed, not only that a date exists. Kept as short text precisely so it can carry meaning without ever being mistaken for assessable evidence.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What the agreed next action is. Context only - not a qualification requirement.
CustomField.label: Next Step
